title: SWF: SceneAndFrameLabelData tag (tag 86)
description: Flash 8 SWF v8 documents can include SceneAndFrameLabelData (tag 86) for scene names. Unit test that a multi-scene FlashDocument exports a tag 86 in the SWF with correct scene count and names. Tests in packages/swf/src/__tests__/sceneframes.test.ts. Check if compile.ts emits tag 86.
